decisions.reason: Having survived the initial post-launch review and fitting tightly with the firm’s core garage-door system business, this operator line would now likely be judged at or above aspiration and retained.

As an incremental extension of the industrial door range, it is likely kept, though its more limited prominence and overlap with related glazed door offerings leave some chance of portfolio pruning if results lag aspiration.

Its insulated glazed design matches German customer demand for compliant thermal-performance industrial solutions, so management would likely see enough strategic and performance value to continue it.

Because this glazed industrial sectional door had stronger visible commitment and has remained in the portfolio after early selection, boundedly rational management would likely keep it unless internal comparisons now show a clear shortfall.
